Planning audit 1: corrections.
Planning correction: SCH-04 / UC11-1 / SCOPE11-6: The planned periodicity workflow only checks manually enumerated occurrence windows. solution-contract.json explicitly makes referenceIntervalMinutes descriptive, and plan.md forbids deriving occurrences from it. This does not cover expanding recurrence rules or detecting an omitted mandatory occurrence. Plan a clearly labeled synthetic recurrence-rule expansion with independently fixed occurrence IDs and deadlines, including cross-week history. Add novel-input, changed-interval/history, and impossible-deadline cases through the delivered interface; retain the unresolved authoritative SFTRM prerequisite and do not claim operational compliance.
Planning correction: UC11-1 / DESC11-3 / SCOPE11-5: The public contract defines negotiation as a report generated only after centralized search succeeds: original preferences are paired with the solver's final allocation. Distinct department labels and a post-hoc counterproposal list do not establish collaborative departmental agents negotiating. Specify departmental proposal-generation and response behavior, shared coordinator exchanges, termination and failure behavior, and independently expected interaction traces. Include a changed departmental preference or priority that changes an agent response and final allocation, plus an impossible negotiation case; map these checks into the acceptance and evaluation plans.

Independent judge: SATISFACTORY. Human review is required.
Judgment 1: NOT
UC11-1, DESC11-3, SCOPE11-5: Collaborative departmental agents negotiating schedules: lib/pb4t.mjs runs centralized boundedSearch and constructs negotiation entries only after finding a solution. Departments supply data and ordering, but no departmental proposal/response behavior participates in negotiation. domain.test.mjs asserts the resulting summary, not agent collaboration. Fix: Implement departmental proposal and counterproposal handlers participating in shared-constraint coordination. Test changed departmental preferences, rejected proposals, backtracking and impossible-case termination using actual exchange traces.
UC11-1, SCH-04, SCOPE11-6: Preserve mandated training periodicities: lib/pb4t.mjs checks only manually enumerated occurrences; referenceIntervalMinutes never determines obligations. Removing both a required occurrence and its drill leaves no mechanism to detect the omission. Deadline tests in domain.test.mjs do not establish recurrence expansion. Fix: Implement a clearly labeled synthetic recurrence-rule model that derives required occurrences from cadence and completion history, detects omitted training, and feeds scheduling. Test changed cadence, multiple weekly occurrences, boundary deadlines and impossible coverage; retain authoritative SFTRM mapping as a human review step.
DELIVERABLE11-1: Personnel loading heatmaps: public/app.js assigns the same background color to every positive daily duty load; .heat in public/styles.css only arranges numeric spans. Different positive loads therefore have identical intensity despite public/index.html stating darker cells mean more minutes. Fix: Map computed load magnitudes to a documented color scale with a legend and accessible numeric values. Test zero, low and high loads, including changed synthetic inputs, and assert distinct ordered intensities.
